summary: Robot Consulting Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, providing notice of its 6th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 26, 2026, in Tokyo, Japan. The meeting agenda includes standard items such as approval of financial statements, election of a statutory auditor, reduction of stated capital and capital reserve to appropriate for loss, and a partial amendment to articles of incorporation. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure; no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is indicated. No deal terms or strategic transactions are present.
